style: Warm-paper noir: flat colour, 5-7 unit ink outlines, rounded shapes; dim slate-blue interrogation room and dawn-blue office cut by one hot orange accent (lamp light, chart line, doorway); recurring cast = rumpled-blazer detective, gear-headed trench-coat suspect, and a pair of chart lines (red clicks, pale impressions) treated as evidence.

panels.subject: Dim interrogation room: detective in rumpled blazer under a single hanging lamp, metal table, a white chart card with two lines in her hand
panels.action: She slides the two-line chart card across the table; card skids, anticipates with a small wind-up, overshoots and settles with a paper flutter; lamp swings from the push-in

panels.subject: Behind the observation glass: gear-headed suspect in a trench coat, handcuffs on wrists, open door glowing at frame right
panels.action: Cuffs spring open and drop out of frame, the gear-head straightens, shrugs directly at camera, then strolls out through the bright doorway

panels.subject: Whip-wipe leftward into the BEFORE side: same detective at a cluttered dawn desk, cold blue window light, monitor glowing, coffee cups, ringing phone
panels.action: The interrogation room streaks off left, the dawn desk streaks in and lands with a small settle; she slumps forward as the phone starts hopping on the desk

panels.subject: Her monitor filling frame: a red line falling off the right edge of a chart, her silhouetted shoulder, phone buzzing in the corner of frame
panels.action: The red line drops another step, the phone rattles the desk and shakes the whole frame once, she pinches the bridge of her nose

panels.subject: Through the office window: a small mob with pitchforks and signs crowding the gear-headed suspect in the street, detective watching from inside
panels.action: Pitchforks jab upward in unison, the gear-head raises both hands and backs into the crowd, her reflection in the glass shakes its head

panels.subject: Wall calendar, corkboard texture, pins scattered across many earlier days, one far-later day ringed in red marker
panels.action: Camera pushes in as pins pop in one by one across the early weeks, then the red circle draws itself last, well after the pins

panels.subject: Her two hands over a second chart, pinching a glowing pale line (impressions) free of it like evidence tape
panels.action: She peels the pale line up out of the chart, it stretches and wobbles with follow-through, then she carries it out of frame toward the clicks chart

panels.subject: The clicks chart on the table, pale impressions line lowering onto it; three suspect silhouettes lining up against a height chart in the background
panels.action: The pale line settles over the red line, the gap between them flares open like a fingerprint under UV and throws hard light across the three waiting suspects

panels.subject: Police lineup: three suspects side by side against a height chart, hard overhead light, detective's silhouette at frame edge
panels.action: The three shuffle into place and freeze, a beam of chart-light sweeps slowly along the row

panels.subject: Suspect number one, folded out of a search-result snippet (title bar for a face), stepping forward under a flat-topped line
panels.action: The flat line locks overhead while the red line slides down beneath it; the snippet-suspect steps forward and its title bar flickers grey

panels.subject: Middle suspect: nervous figure clutching a five-item checklist, both chart lines tumbling down behind it
panels.action: Both lines tumble together and slam into the lower frame, the light snaps onto the middle suspect, the checklist rattles and five boxes tick in fast

panels.subject: Third suspect: an empty hood with nothing inside, its section of the lineup dark and vacant
panels.action: Both lines vanish off the chart, a tumbleweed rolls past the empty hood, dust settles in the abandoned spotlight

panels.subject: Front desk of the station: gear-headed suspect signing a clipboard, exit door ajar behind it, detective watching from the corridor
panels.action: It scrawls a signature, taps the pen down, tips an imaginary hat and walks out; the door swings and settles

panels.subject: Clean bright corkboard, detective's hands pressing the two-line chart card into place at the right end
panels.action: She lines the card up, presses the pin home with a small wind-up, and lets the card rock once and settle straight

panels.subject: The whole corkboard: a long ribbon of past monthly chart cards stretching sideways out of frame, both lines running through every one
panels.action: Camera pulls out fast and the ribbon of months unspools left, the paired lines joining card to card into one continuous read

panels.subject: The interrogation room, lights lifting to warm: detective capping her pen, the empty chair, the open door the gear-head left through
panels.action: She caps the pen with a click, the chair slides itself back under the table, and the camera drifts past her toward the bright open door
